policy.current_rule: A promotion is labeled Current when its status is current and it has been verified within the freshness window. A passed published end date never auto-marks a promotion ended: it stays current with a review_reason until endedness is verified with evidence (approved promo lifecycle, 2026-10-14).
policy.end_date_rule: If a provider does not publish an end date, do not invent one. Show the last-confirmed-active date instead.
policy.ranking_rule: Affiliate availability and commission amounts do not determine display order.

promotions.title: 12-month unlimited prepaid plan: $20/mo equivalent ($240 upfront)
promotions.summary: New single-line customers can prepay $240 for 12 months of unlimited talk, text and data, with 16GB of high-speed data before speeds are limited to 1.5Mbps and 10GB hotspot data.
promotions.eligibility: Online only; new single line, SIM or phone purchase and activation required. Taxes and fees extra. Annual upfront payment required; no published offer end date.

promotions.title: 10-Year Anniversary: any 6-month plan for $10/mo
promotions.summary: For a limited time, new Mint Mobile customers can get any 6-month plan, including Unlimited, for $10/mo. A $60 upfront payment is required for the first six months.
promotions.eligibility: New customers only. Offer applies to the first 6 months; full-price plan options apply after the promotional term. Taxes and fees are extra. Purchase must be activated within Mint's stated activation window.
promotions.verification_note: Confirmed live Oct 15, 2026 via manual check of mintmobile.com/plans/ FCC labels: all four 6-month tiers at $10/mo introductory rate ($60 upfront). No published end date.

promotions.title: 12-month introductory pricing on Essentials, Unleashed and Unleashed Max
promotions.summary: Viasat advertises 12-month introductory pricing for new residential customers: Essentials starting at $39.99/mo then $69.99/mo, Unleashed starting at $69.99/mo then $99.99/mo, and Unleashed Max starting at $109.99/mo then $179.99/mo.
promotions.eligibility: Limited-time offer for new residential customers on eligible plans. Address-specific availability applies, and a $15/mo equipment lease fee is additional. Verify current terms before ordering.

promotions.title: Up to $200 in bill credits on qualifying new-line activations
promotions.summary: Get up to $200 off per qualifying new phone line through $5.56 monthly bill credits for 36 months when ordering online or by phone with an eligible wireless plan.
promotions.eligibility: New phone line and eligible wireless plan required. Order online or by phone. Confirm device-specific eligibility, credit timing and continued-service requirements directly with AT&T. Limited time; no published end date.

promotions.title: Limited-time introductory savings
promotions.summary: Plans start at $39.99/mo for the first 12 months in eligible areas. Introductory savings are $10/mo on Lite and $25/mo on other eligible plans; plans revert to their standard monthly fee after 12 months.
promotions.eligibility: New subscribers only; geographic exclusions apply. Equipment lease or purchase fees are extra; minimum term and early termination fees apply. Continued $5/mo ACH savings require bank-account enrollment before the second billing cycle. Verify address-specific rates.

promotions.title: Four new Unlimited Welcome lines: $27.50/line/mo with Auto Pay
promotions.summary: Verizon currently advertises four new Unlimited Welcome lines for $27.50 per line per month ($110/month for four lines), plus taxes and fees. This offer is kept separate from standard plan pricing.
promotions.eligibility: Four new lines on Unlimited Welcome and Auto Pay required. Check current offer-credit, paper-free billing, payment-method and continued-service conditions directly with Verizon before ordering; no published offer end date.

promotions.title: Extra $5/month off each new line for 12 months (4+ lines)
promotions.summary: Eligible new lines receive an additional $5/month discount for 12 months when the account maintains at least four Unlimited Your Way plans. This temporary discount is separate from the regular AutoPay and paperless billing discount.
promotions.eligibility: Limited time; maintain at least four Unlimited Your Way plans. Advertised plan prices also require qualifying AutoPay and paperless billing; taxes and fees extra. Confirm eligible lines, discount start dates and whether other credits can be combined. No published end date.

promotions.title: Tiered BYOD credits: up to $10/mo on Premium/Extra, $5/mo on Value
promotions.summary: Eligible new BYOD lines can receive up to $360 over 36 months on Premium 2.0 or Extra 2.0 (up to $10/mo), or $5/mo for up to 36 months on qualifying Value 2.0 lines. Temporary credits remain separate from regular rates.
promotions.eligibility: Premium/Extra offer requires port-in of a new line with your own smartphone; $35 activation and other terms apply. Value pricing disclosures require a new BYOD smartphone and eligible AutoPay + paperless billing. Verify credit start dates, continued-service requirements and whether other offers combine. No published end date.
promotions.verification_note: Partial re-verification October 14, 2026: the $5/mo Value 2.0 tier is confirmed in the plan FAQ footnote; the up-to-$10/mo Premium/Extra tier was not fully re-verified this run.

promotions.title: Up to $800 per line in switcher reward cards
promotions.summary: Eligible switchers can receive a reward card toward their previous phone balance, up to $800 per line and up to 10 lines. This is phone-balance reimbursement, not an automatic $800 service discount.
promotions.eligibility: Redemption required. Eligible switching and outstanding phone-balance conditions apply; confirm required documentation, submission deadlines, eligible plans and service requirements before switching. No published end date.

promotions.title: Free EasyCare with Unleashed Max ($9.99/mo value)
promotions.summary: Viasat advertises free EasyCare, a $9.99/mo value, with Unleashed Max. This is a plan benefit and does not reduce the internet service rate.
promotions.eligibility: Eligible Unleashed Max service required; address-specific availability applies. Confirm how long included EasyCare remains free and the terms if you change plans. No published offer end date.

promotions.title: CyberProtect: first month free, then $6.99/mo
promotions.summary: New CyberProtect customers receive the first month free; the regular add-on charge is $6.99/mo afterward.
promotions.eligibility: Available only to Viasat Internet residential customers who are new CyberProtect customers. Applicable taxes and surcharges extra. Confirm ongoing billing and cancellation terms. No published offer end date.

promotions.title: EasyCare introductory savings for the first three months
promotions.summary: EasyCare and EasyCare+ are free for the first three months, then $9.99/mo and $14.99/mo respectively. EasyCare Premium is $9.99/mo for three months, then $24.99/mo.
promotions.eligibility: Enroll within 30 days of Viasat Internet installation. EasyCare/EasyCare+ unavailable in AK or HI; Premium unavailable in AK, HI, CA or FL. Confirm Premium availability, ongoing charges and whether an included Unleashed Max benefit applies instead. No published offer end date.

promotions.title: 5OFF5: $5/mo off Visible+ or Visible+ Pro for 60 months
promotions.summary: New members who port in an eligible number get $5/mo off the $35/mo Visible+ plan or $5/mo off the $45/mo Visible+ Pro plan for the first 60 months by entering promo code 5OFF5 at checkout.
promotions.eligibility: New members only. Port-in from an eligible carrier required within 30 days of activation; monthly Visible+ or Visible+ Pro plan required (annual plans excluded); bring your own device or purchase a new device. Discount forfeited if you switch to an ineligible plan or terminate service; it continues at $5/mo if you move between eligible plans without restarting the 60-month period. Cannot combine with other service or device promotions or Inner Circle credits. $5 minimum monthly service charge; taxes and fees are included in the amount paid.
promotions.verification_note: Verified October 14, 2026 on the official Visible deals page. Offer disclosure: ends 10/29/2026 at 11:59pm EST.
